(Search snippet content — full article not fetched; summary of Araghchi MoU statement reported across outlets)

Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi, in a post on X on Tuesday 7 July 2026, cited Paragraph 13 of the Islamabad MoU, writing: "Para 13 of the MoU is clear: Negotiations on final Deal will not commence if threats continue."

Araghchi's remarks followed US President Donald Trump's warning that Washington would either secure a deal with Tehran or "finish the job" if diplomacy failed.

The Islamabad MoU, brokered by Pakistan, entered into force on June 18 2026 after Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Trump signed it electronically. It calls for indirect talks between Iran and the US while committing both sides to refrain from the threat or use of force against each other.
